findings.message: sensitive GitHub token permissions: contents:write, id-token:write
findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records within the granted scope.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants a named write scope; exploitability depends on whether untrusted code reaches that job.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: attempts path traversal with encoded or nested patterns
findings.remediation: Use path.resolve() and verify the result stays within the workspace root.
findings.impact: Path traversal with encoded patterns (%2e%2e%2f) or nested ../.. can escape any path-based sandbox.
findings.attack_vector: URL-encoded or nested traversal sequences — bypass naive path validation that only checks single ../.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes request-controlled input directly to a file mutation API
findings.remediation: Map external identifiers to server-owned paths and enforce a resolved workspace boundary before mutation.
findings.impact: Request-controlled paths can overwrite, rename, chmod, or delete files outside the intended workspace.
findings.attack_vector: A request body/query/parameter value reaches a file mutation call without an evident resolved-path boundary.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: uses string concatenation or char-code construction to hide keywords
findings.remediation: Use readable, explicit code patterns; avoid character-code obfuscation.
findings.impact: Character-code construction hides string literals from grep-based detection.
findings.attack_vector: String.fromCharCode() builds dangerous strings at runtime — evades static patterns.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
